description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Specifications" name="Airplane specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements_Russian" name="Requirements for Russian team"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements_Irish" name="Requirements for Irish team"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Parts_Russian" name="Manufactured parts from Russian team"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Parts_Irish" name="Manufactured parts from Irish team"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AirplaneDelivery" name="Airplane delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Produce luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Specifications" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" name="Send requirements to teams"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirementsRussian" name="Send requirements to Russian team" messageRef="Message_Requirements_Russian"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirementsIrish" name="Send requirements to Irish team" messageRef="Message_Requirements_Irish"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePartsRussian" name="Receive parts from Russian team" messageRef="Message_Parts_Russian"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePartsIrish" name="Receive parts from Irish team" messageRef="Message_Parts_Irish"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin" name="All parts received"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Conduct test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProtocol" name="Create test protocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProtocol" name="Send test protocol to producer and customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer" messageRef="Message_AirplaneDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DeliveryConfirmation" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_01" sourceRef="Start_Specifications" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_02" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" targetRef="Task_SendRequirementsRussian"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_03" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" targetRef="Task_SendRequirementsIrish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_04" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsRussian" targetRef="Task_ReceivePartsRussian"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_05" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsIrish" targetRef="Task_ReceivePartsIrish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_06" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePartsRussian" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_07" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePartsIrish" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_08" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_09" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Task_TestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_10" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Task_CreateProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_11" sourceRef="Task_CreateProtocol" targetRef="Task_SendProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_12" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_13" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_14" sourceRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmation" targetRef="End_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Specify and receive luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Begin specification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseSpecifications" name="Choose bar, number of seats, color and toilet water amount"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send airplane specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProtocol" name="Receive test protocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAirplane" name="Receive airplane" messageRef="Message_AirplaneDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ConfirmDelivery" name="Confirm delivery" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_01" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_02" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_03" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_05" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_06" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RussianTeam" name="Manufacture parts - Russian team" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RussianRequirements" name="Requirements received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RequirementsRussian" messageRef="Message_Requirements_Russian"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureRussianParts" name="Manufacture assigned airplane parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRussianParts" name="Send manufactured parts" messageRef="Message_Parts_Russian"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RussianPartsSent" name="Parts sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Russian_01" sourceRef="Start_RussianRequirements" targetRef="Task_ManufactureRussianParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Russian_02" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureRussianParts" targetRef="Task_SendRussianParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Russian_03" sourceRef="Task_SendRussianParts" targetRef="End_RussianPartsSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_IrishTeam" name="Manufacture parts - Irish team" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_IrishRequirements" name="Requirements received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RequirementsIrish" messageRef="Message_Requirements_Irish"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureIrishParts" name="Manufacture assigned airplane parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendIrishParts" name="Send manufactured parts" messageRef="Message_Parts_Irish"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_IrishPartsSent" name="Parts sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Irish_01" sourceRef="Start_IrishRequirements" targetRef="Task_ManufactureIrishParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Irish_02" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureIrishParts" targetRef="Task_SendIrishParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Irish_03" sourceRef="Task_SendIrishParts" targetRef="End_IrishPartsSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Airplane producer" processRef="Process_Producer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_RussianTeam" name="Russian team" processRef="Process_RussianTeam"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IrishTeam" name="Irish team" processRef="Process_IrishTeam"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Send specifications" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Start_Specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequirementsRussian" name="Send requirements to Russian team" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsRussian" targetRef="Start_RussianRequirements" messageRef="Message_Requirements_Russian"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequirementsIrish" name="Send requirements to Irish team" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsIrish" targetRef="Start_IrishRequirements" messageRef="Message_Requirements_Irish"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartsRussian" name="Return manufactured parts" sourceRef="Task_SendRussianParts" targetRef="Task_ReceivePartsRussian" messageRef="Message_Parts_Russian"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartsIrish" name="Return manufactured parts" sourceRef="Task_SendIrishParts" targetRef="Task_ReceivePartsIrish" messageRef="Message_Parts_Irish"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AirplaneDelivery" name="Deliver airplane" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" messageRef="Message_AirplaneDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Confirm delivery" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmation" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
